title: Chapter 83 Red Fire Beast
content:
Chapter 83 Red Fire Beast

Cao Cao's army went all the way to the north. On the way, the army lined up, forming a linear advance, stretching for dozens of miles, like a big net fishing for fish, constantly searching for every tribe encountered along the way.

Soon, the army had traveled three hundred miles, and the north of the entire southeastern region had been swept over. A population of 12,000 people was captured, and all of them were sent to various major traffic roads, and villages and towns were established as supply points for the army along the way.

Going a dozen miles further, it is the scope of the northern region, where the tribes are generally stronger than the southeastern region because they often struggle with foreign forces.

Moreover, Cao Cao's army was so powerful that the army was divided into dozens of miles and marched hand in hand, ploughing the entire northeast of the southeast region all the way.

With such a large-scale attack, it is naturally impossible to guarantee that no one slips through the net. There will always be some people who can escape to the north and pass on the news of the enemy's attack in the south.

Now, the news has reached the overlord of the north, the Creland tribe. However, the Creeland tribe still has some scruples about the unknown army in the south.

The opponent's army can have 50,000 of him, which is almost equivalent to all the soldiers and horses that the entire alliance can come up with! In his entire northern region, there are only 15,000 people who can take it out.

It's still hard to make up your mind to let the Creeland tribe resist this army's attack. So he planned to let the Ansen tribe, a large tribe of 5,000 people in the south, lead several small tribes around that tribe to test the reality of that army.

If the army was just a sham, the Ansen tribe would be enough to deal with it. It was just that they had foresight and knew that the army was just a silver gun and candle head, unusable, and only one Ansen tribe was needed to resist.

If the Ansen tribe can't do it for a day or two, then they need to think about the way back. It is to surrender on the spot, or to seek help from the leader of the alliance, or simply lead the army of the northern kingdom of Ryan into the northern area, and let the two armies fight to the death.

The leader of the Creeland tribe was in the city lord's mansion, which usually symbolized the authority of the patriarch, in the city of Creeland. The two legs kept walking, the complexion on his face changed, and he was very entangled in thinking about how to deal with the strategy of the southern army.

In the end, Boris, the head of the Criland tribe, made up his mind with a cross on his face, and shouted to the guards outside the door.

The guard heard the cries of his patriarch and hurriedly came to the hall, only to see that his patriarch was writing and drawing on the desk at the moment, and the special parchment usually used for ordering was already full of words at this moment.

After a while, their patriarch stopped, picked up the parchment in his hand, blew it, and carefully checked whether there were any mistakes.

After finding nothing wrong, it was rolled up and placed in a copper cylinder. He handed it over to the guard in front of him and let him go to the large tribe of 5,000 people in the south, reading the order in the cylinder.

The guard received the order, put the cylinder into his arms, carefully protected it, and then came to the courtyard, and gathered twenty guards to go to the southern Ansen tribe with him.

A group of people came to the courtyard, and the red fire beast, the lost original special product used for walking, walked quickly towards the south.

This kind of red fire beast is the most common magical beast in the Lost Plains. This kind of monster has a gentle personality and long-lasting endurance. It can travel hundreds of miles a day. If it is trained, it can also be trained as a war beast, and it can lead the army to the battlefield on the battlefield.

However, although there are various advantages, this kind of monster can almost be said to be not a monster. The reason why it is called a beast is because there is a trace of fire attribute aura in his body that is almost weak.

The so-called training of red fire beasts into war beasts is through different secret techniques, supplemented by some special medicinal materials, and undergoes some special training.

The fire attribute vindictiveness in the red fire beast's body is slowly grown, and condensed into a very weak magical beast crystal nucleus. After using this magical beast crystal core, the aggression of the red fire beast will be greatly improved.

Just like human beings, when they have no ability or strength, they can only be regarded as turtles, but once they develop, they will show off their abilities in various ways, and it is the same when they are replaced by monsters.

Warcraft in this world, possessing Dou Qi and condensing into a Warcraft crystal nucleus, can become a second-order Warcraft. After that, as long as he continuously refines his Warcraft Crystal Nucleus to make the Dou Qi energy of his Warcraft Crystal Nuclei more pure and stronger, he can gradually upgrade his ranks.

As for the Scarlet Fire Beast, it was originally extremely difficult to advance, and often only one of the thousands of them could advance to the second rank. After the barbarian tribe discovered this beast, they domesticated him.

After experimenting again and again, I finally came up with different ways to quickly advance Warcraft. In the end, a shortcut was finally found, which could allow those red fire beasts to directly advance to the second-order.

Of course, being promoted to a second-order beast through this shortcut method is considered the weakest among all second-order beasts.

Even the second-order monster Aoki Rabbit, who is said to have no offensive power and only eat herbs, is not as effective as a second-order monster. At the very least, Aoki Rabbit can cast his natural spells, but the Chihuo Beast has no natural spells because it was spawned.

But no matter what, the undeniable fact is that the red fire beast is indeed a second-order, and his combat power can offset several first-order soldiers.

The training method used in the Edra Tribal Alliance, the trained red fire beasts are faster, the guards did not take much time, but in just three hours, they came across a hundred miles to the big one in the south. tribe.

Before reaching the Ansen tribe's camp, there was a hint of pride and disdain on his face. On the entire plain, only tribes with more than 10,000 people have the energy and ability to build cities.

The big tribe in front of them, although they are also trying to build a decent city, found that their ability and material resources were insufficient, so they could only build such a simple city.

He stopped in front of the camp at the gate, and shouted to the guards of the camp, the commander of the north, the supreme male lion, sent an order to let their leader come out and accept the order!

The male lion is a special title on the entire plain. Only the leaders of the forces with more than 10,000 people can be crowned with the honorable title and awe of the male lion.

The guards who stopped in front of the door looked at the guards in front of them with angry and scared expressions on their faces. The guards in front of them can ride noble mounts like the Scarlet Fire Beast.

The status is definitely noble, and the strength is also a big man with fighting spirit above the second rank. Although the number of Scarlet Fire Beasts was said to be not large in the entire loss, it was not many. In the entire plain, the total of the three forces was estimated to be about ten thousand.

And not every one can be trained as a battle cavalry, and there are many things that cannot be trained into a battle cavalry, and can only be raised as a beast.

It is estimated that the three forces in the entire plain only have his three thousand red fire beasts to ride. The Edel Tribe Alliance is even smaller, and it can only believe in fewer fire beasts, only a mere 800.

There are even fewer assigned to the northern region, but more than 100. Then it will be shared among the various tribes. I dare not say it elsewhere. Even their own tribe is only a mere dozen or so. Usually, only the patriarchs and elders can ride.

Therefore, these guards, through these red fire beasts, can conclude that these people must be more noble than them, and their strength is also very powerful. Among the barbarian tribes, only the strong can enjoy powerful mounts.

Can only dare to be angry and dare not speak, quickly send people to the clan to inform the patriarch and elders, and come to deal with these people with unknown intentions and bad attitudes.
